lead_raw_text:
The orthorhombic crystal Li4Ti2Ni4O12 (Li2TiNi2O6) adopts space group Amm2 (No. 38), with 22 atoms per unit cell distributed over 8 independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies octahedral Ni centers coordinated by six O neighbors, and tetrahedral Ti centers coordinated by four O neighbors; Li also shows four-coordinate O environments. The NiO6 octahedra share corners with one another, and corner-sharing is additionally observed between Ni octahedra and Ti tetrahedra. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 22 sites.
